comparison.objective: Rotate an open shell 90 degrees around a held shaft while both are airborne.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual relative-pose control around an axis.
comparison.success_condition: Measured 90-degree shell-to-shaft relation with both bodies clear of the table; detailed tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Relative in-air clocking lacks threaded adjustment, locking, and post-lock functional cycles.
